adjudications.reason: The unique casting-vote role identifies the partner and explains why the writer complied. A personal name adds no needed responsibility.
The preceding rule makes purchasing the department responsible for a binding order; responsible department recovers that role by implication.
Singular they has referee as its only supplied personal antecedent. The role needed to validate the stoppage is recoverable.

The missing executor is the recipient of the transfer. The performer of the transfer and the reader carrying out the return are not obscured by this omission; recipient identification is outside this named type.
The parents can wait for the designated coach to call without knowing which coach it is. The omitted identity is immaterial to the stated instruction.
The supplied concern is whether Dad has company, and acceptance resolves that concern. The passage never requires the twins to be distinguished.
The review limits responsibility to the director and operator, and identifies the operator as the follower. The director is recoverable as the giver of the instruction.
Other person is the partner relative to the narrator. That person accepts the decision-maker terms, recovering the narrator as the person who ended the engagement.
The rule authorizes an employee and excludes a customer. Describing the waiver entrant as authorized therefore supplies the employee role needed to understand acceptance.
The stated rule permits only a supervisor to make a binding halt request. Acceptance because of role identifies a supervisor by implication.
The judge is the sole supplied source of a compulsory instruction. Treating compliance as compulsory on the issuing authority recovers the judge role.
The alternatives are a voluntary signature or pressure from the chair. The finding of pressure selects the latter and identifies its actor.
The opening procedure explicitly assigns label certification to the technician. The later assertion that no role is supplied contradicts that assignment; the actor role is recoverable.
Only the choreographer can authorize the lift change. Treating the request as authorized on its origin recovers the choreographer as requester.
The report classifies shutdown as a preventable decision requiring retraining, selecting the operator rather than the automatic heat protection. That role explains the event.
The writer explicitly explains why the brother rather than the uncle must replace the window, and assigns responsibility to its thrower. Together those statements recover the brother as thrower.
The captain is the only role whose concession is valid. Accepting the concession on the sender position recovers the captain.
Protection depends on a manager ordering deletion. Granting protection because of the source of that order supplies the manager role.
The opening rule permits an instructor to excuse an absence and restricts a receptionist to recording it. Relying on the excusing authority recovers the instructor.
The committee is the only supplied source of a binding playground closure. Presenting the closure as binding because of its maker supplies the committee by implication.
Departing pilot repeats the person surrendering control instead of distinguishing the crew member. The log explicitly undertakes to establish that responsibility, so the omission remains a hit.

Each floor requires one responsible officer, but the complete plan gives neither officer-to-floor assignment. Officers cannot select their required floor from the supplied instruction; the missing allocation of responsibility is the defect.

Authorized engineer merely repeats the unknown recipient of authority. The text permits only one of two engineers to act but supplies no distinguishing role or identity. Assuming an unshown authorization would import external context.

Both machine positions must be staffed by different people, and the instruction tells the reader to take an assigned position without giving that assignment. Knowing that positions were assigned does not recover who feeds and who operates the stop switch.
The account uses an unsigned finder note to select between two housemates. The supplied writing gives no identifying handwriting or other context; importing it would invent a repair.

The return instruction depends on who sewed the dress, distinguished from its seller. Maker repeats the unknown performer; sewn to order identifies no maker. The responsible recipient of the required return remains unresolved.

The first replacement stated an open review question, permitting honest uncertainty. The revision makes the review completed and assigns liability and a claims destination through the unidentified speaker. The final objection is resolved by that operational need for the speaker and employer, rather than a supposed duty to know every speaker.

The passage delivers a completed log billing claim that depends on which observatory initiated the reset. Its final sentence acknowledges omitted attribution but leaves the delivered charge without a responsible observatory. It is an operational account rather than discussion or criticism of bad prose.

The first version allowed a single-technician reading, under which the role alone could identify the actor. The final context names two technicians on the same photograph, preserving the responsibility question while making the missing distinction explicit. Blind review of the final text returned a hit without objection.
